name: What factors should I consider when hiring a general contractor for a master bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when hiring a general contractor for a master bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: When hiring a general contractor, look for experience, strong communication skills, and a proven track record. Verify their licensing and insurance to ensure they are properly credentialed. Request references and review their portfolio to assess the quality of their work. A reliable contractor will provide a clear, detailed contract, a realistic timeline, and transparent pricing. We pride ourselves on our professionalism, craftsmanship, and commitment to client satisfaction throughout the entire remodeling process.
acceptedAnswer.description: When hiring a contractor, consider their experience, communication, licensing, insurance, references, portfolio, and transparent contracting.
